name: Knee Deep!: In Love
source:
Welcome to Pebblestone University! 

Life’s about to get much more complicated when you find out… your childhood best friend Milo, your assassin roommate Anthony, and your artist classmate Rylee are all willing… to kill for you??? 

Navigate campus life, look through creepy social media posts online, and try not to flunk your finals while figuring out who’s a sweetheart, who’s a yandere, and who might just be both. Choose your favorite, and see if you can make it to graduation with your heart and your other admirers still intact.

[From [url=https://comfortkuma.itch.io/knee-deep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到鹅卵石大学！

当你发现……你儿时最好的朋友米洛、你的刺客室友安东尼和你的艺术家同学莱利都愿意……为你杀人时，生活将变得更加复杂？？？

畅游校园生活，浏览网上令人毛骨悚然的社交媒体帖子，并尽量不要在期末考试中不及格，同时弄清楚谁是甜心，谁是病娇，谁可能两者兼而有之。选择你最喜欢的，看看你是否能在毕业时保持你的心和你的其他崇拜者完好无损。

[来自[url=https://comfortkuma.itch.io/knee-deep]itch.io[/url]]
